fact: ESCCOM's Cybersecurity Agency, called the National Cybersecurity Agency, is stated to operate nationally, with a Cybersecurity Incident Response Officer and a proof of concept of an incident response and information sharing platform (IRIS); the date 2026-10-05 is inferred by the source's metadata from a Monday event reported on 2026-10-08.
The Director of Public Prosecutions is stated to be working with a National Cyber Incident Response Team, among others, on cybercrime investigations and prosecutions.

The World Bank PID states a National Cybersecurity Strategy (2022) was formulated, providing a strategic roadmap, while noting no national CSIRT and no Critical Information Infrastructure framework yet exist.
Prime Minister Dlamini announced that the Eswatini Communications Commission has been formally designated the National Cybersecurity Agency, with a fully operational Cyber Incident Response Team.
The Prime Minister cited the National Cybersecurity Strategy 2022-2027 as part of the country's digital defence framework.
ESCCOM's Assistant Director for Cybersecurity says the Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act of 2022 (s.52) designated the Eswatini Communications Commission as the national cybersecurity agency.
The document names Eswatini's National Cybersecurity Agency (NCA) as running a 2024 awareness campaign; it does not state how the agency was created.

ESCCOM, which its chief executive calls the National Cybersecurity Agency, launched investigations into ransomware attacks on public entities including the Eswatini Water Services Corporation, after an alert from its threat intelligence tools.

A Ministry of ICT engineer says the Ministry established the National Cybersecurity Agency at ESCCOM to coordinate all cybersecurity issues, with the National Computer Incident Response Team (NCIRT) established under it.
A Ministry of ICT engineer says Government developed the National Cybersecurity Strategy 2022-2027.
